csv_scope_of_work: A/E s must demonstrate the capability to self-perform at least three (3) of the following core Architectural/Engineering Services disciplines and provide a demonstrated history of subcontracting for the balance within the past three (3) years: Architecture Civil Engineering Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) Engineering Structural Engineering Geotechnical Engineering Roof Consulting Other Related Professional Services, which can be provided with the TMD anticipates the need for professional services across multiple facilities in Texas. A/E's own forces or through qualified professionals subcontracted to the A/E, are: Facility Assessments Enhanced Commissioning Cost Estimating Energy Audits and Conservation Registered Accessibility Specialists Fire Protection Engineering Water Proofing Test and Balance Master Planning Surveying Materials Testing Historic Preservation Security Environmental Hazardous Material Testing and Remediation Airfield Design Professional Consulting Range Complex Design.

title: Architectural & Engineering Services
short_description: Framework-style A/E services for multiple Texas Military Department facilities across Texas.
project_location: Austin, Texas, with multiple facilities across Texas, USA
project_scope: Professional architectural and engineering services for multiple Texas Military Department facilities across Texas. The notice covers a broad range of disciplines including architecture, civil engineering, MEP engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, roof consulting, and related professional services. Additional possible tasks include facility assessments, enhanced commissioning, cost estimating, energy audits, accessibility, fire protection, waterproofing, test and balance, master planning, surveying, materials testing, historic preservation, security, environmental and hazardous material testing and remediation, airfield design, professional consulting, and range complex design. No specific building sizes, spans, or individual project technical parameters are stated.
services: On-call architectural and engineering services; bidders must self-perform at least 3 core disciplines from architecture, civil engineering, MEP, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, roof consulting, and related services, with subcontracting history for remaining disciplines. Contract duration is 36 months with a 12-month renewal option; one or more contracts may be awarded.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a broad multi-discipline on-call/framework-style A/E procurement without a defined specific structure.
- The notice is focused on general building and military facilities rather than bridges, long-span roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
- Structural engineering is included, but only as one discipline among many and without identifiable technically demanding scope.
- Military facility context is generally low priority for sbp.
- No concrete project data such as spans, areas, or innovative structural requirements are provided.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The procurement is for indefinite professional services across multiple facilities, so no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget is stated. As this is a multi-facility on-call A/E services contract with undefined task orders, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Bidders must demonstrate capability to self-perform at least three core A/E disciplines and show a demonstrated history within the past three years of subcontracting for the remaining required disciplines.

notes: Project #: 862622. Solicitation No.: TMD26-CFMO-4012026. Target market: General Building. County: Travis. State: Southern Texas. Questions deadline: 2026-05-20 04:00 PM CDT. One or more contracts may be awarded. Renewable contract with 36-month base period and 12-month renewal option. The notice appears to be an indefinite, multi-project services procurement rather than a single defined project.
